skcm_pt01_braf_v600e_vemurafenib_resista.title: Patient SKCM-01: Superficial Spreading Melanoma with BRAF V600E and Acquired NRAS Reactivation Bypass
skcm_pt01_braf_v600e_vemurafenib_resista.citation: BRIM-3 Trial; Nazarian et al. (2010) Nature; Wagle et al. (2011) JCO

clinical_history.primary_driver: BRAF V600E activating mutation with secondary NRAS Q61K acquired bypass
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Initial tumor shrinkage for 5.1 months, then explosive subcutaneous and lung metastases, death at 10.2 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Acquired NRAS mutation switches signaling through CRAF homodimers and hyperactivates PI3K, restoring ERK flux despite Vemurafenib

skcm_pt02_nras_q61r_hyperactivated_refra.title: Patient SKCM-02: Nodular Cutaneous Melanoma with NRAS Q61R Driving Dual CRAF and PI3K Flux
skcm_pt02_nras_q61r_hyperactivated_refra.citation: NEMO Trial; Dummer et al. (2017) Lancet Oncol; Johnson et al. (2015) CCR

clinical_history.primary_driver: NRAS Q61R GTPase-deficient mutation, wild-type BRAF, high CRAF expression
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Transient disease stabilization for 2.8 months, rapid axillary nodal progression and liver lesions, death at 7.4 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: MEK inhibition induces rapid feedback release of CRAF and hyperactivates PI3K/Akt, rescuing MITF and Cyclin D1

skcm_pt03_braf_pten_double_null_fulminan.title: Patient SKCM-03: Fulminant Trunk Melanoma with Concurrent BRAF V600E and Biallelic PTEN Deletion
skcm_pt03_braf_pten_double_null_fulminan.citation: COMBI-d Trial; Long et al. (2017) Lancet Oncol; Paraiso et al. (2011) Cancer Res

clinical_history.primary_driver: BRAF V600E mutation, homozygous PTEN deletion, constitutive Akt phosphorylation
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Primary resistance with disease progression at 3.2 months, multiple brain metastases, death at 6.8 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: PTEN deletion maintains unchecked PI3K/Akt signaling, continuously stabilizing Mcl-1 and inactivating BAD despite complete MAPK blockade

skcm_pt04_braf_wt_checkpoint_exceptional.title: Patient SKCM-04: High Mutational Burden Wild-Type Melanoma with Complete Immunotherapy Remission
skcm_pt04_braf_wt_checkpoint_exceptional.citation: CheckMate-067 Trial; Wolchok et al. (2017) NEJM; Snyder et al. (2014) NEJM

clinical_history.subtype: Triple-Wild-Type Cutaneous Melanoma (High UV Mutational Load)
clinical_history.primary_driver: Extensive UV-induced C>T transitions, wild-type BRAF/NRAS/cKIT, intact p53 axis
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Complete pathological and radiological response (CR), ongoing disease-free survival >60 months (SURVIVED / Cured)
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Intact intrinsic apoptotic machinery; absence of oncogene-driven Bcl-2/Mcl-1 locks permits rapid cytotoxic lymphocyte granzyme-mediated death

skcm_pt05_ckit_l576p_acral_mucosal_resis.title: Patient SKCM-05: Acral Lentiginous Subungual Melanoma with c-KIT L576P and Autocrine HGF Bypass
skcm_pt05_ckit_l576p_acral_mucosal_resis.citation: Carvajal et al. (2011) JAMA; Guo et al. (2011) JCO; TCGA-SKCM

clinical_history.primary_driver: c-KIT exon 11 L576P activating point mutation, high autocrine HGF/c-MET stromal secretion
clinical_history.hospital_treatment: Imatinib mesylate (KIT receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor)
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Progression-free survival of 3.6 months, bulky groin lymphadenopathy and visceral metastases, death at 8.9 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Secondary autocrine HGF secretion activates parallel RTK signaling and drives sustained STAT3/Mcl-1 survival transcription

skcm_pt06_nf1_null_desmoplastic_hypermut.title: Patient SKCM-06: Desmoplastic Neurotropic Melanoma with Biallelic NF1 Tumor Suppressor Loss
skcm_pt06_nf1_null_desmoplastic_hypermut.citation: Krauthammer et al. (2015) Nature Genetics; TCGA-SKCM; Eroglu et al. (2018) Nature

clinical_history.primary_driver: Biallelic loss-of-function NF1 nonsense mutation, loss of Neurofibromin GTPase-activating function
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Primary chemo-refractory, perineural invasion along cranial nerves, death at 6.2 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: NF1 loss hyper-stabilizes wild-type RAS-GTP loading, continuously feeding both MAPK and PI3K/Akt survival loops

skcm_pt07_mitf_amplified_stem_mesenchyma.title: Patient SKCM-07: MITF-Amplified Pigmented Melanoma with Wnt-Driven BCL2 Hyper-Dependence
skcm_pt07_mitf_amplified_stem_mesenchyma.citation: Garraway et al. (2005) Nature; Broad Institute SKCM; Tirosh et al. (2016) Science

clinical_history.primary_driver: High-level focal MITF genomic amplification, concurrent Wnt/beta-catenin nuclear flux
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Rapid recurrence at 3.4 months, widespread cutaneous in-transit and hepatic metastases, death at 7.9 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: MITF amplification directly drives massive Bcl-2 and Cyclin D1 transcription, establishing an impenetrable anti-apoptotic lock

skcm_pt08_pan_refractory_quadruple_pathw.title: Patient SKCM-08: Pan-Refractory Quadruple-Pathway Quadruple-Mutant Metastatic Melanoma
skcm_pt08_pan_refractory_quadruple_pathw.citation: Hodis et al. (2012) Cell; TCGA-SKCM Consortium; Hugo et al. (2016) Cell

clinical_history.primary_driver: Concurrent BRAF V600K, PTEN loss, CDKN2A deletion, TP53 mut, high autocrine HGF
clinical_history.hospital_treatment: Ipilimumab + Nivolumab followed by Dabrafenib + Trametinib
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Progression-free survival of 1.7 months, disseminated leptomeningeal and splenic metastases, death at 4.1 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Simultaneous disruption of MAPK, PI3K, p53, and cell cycle checkpoints induces constitutive MCL-1, BCL-xL, and XIAP expression
